description: Guarantees full session capture and backend trace propagation for every session of the bitdrift-shop-opentelemetry iOS demo app (ai.bitdrift.oteldemo.ios), scoped to that app ID only. Without this, `isTracingActive` stays false for every session, so the SDK never injects trace headers or exports OTel spans (basic screen-view/log capture happens regardless). Fires on APP_LAUNCH with no sampling and no additional match conditions, so it captures 100% of sessions for this app; it is not narrowed to a single device.
